//: MOTIONS BEFORE THE SENATE (GDD §6.1 'the Senate... voting blocs'; GAP §10 item 2). A house of standing (a baron, or a head who is a Judge or better) moves one of these for `proposeInfluence`; it sits on the docket a turn while houses are lobbied, and is voted at the end of the next turn by weight — Senate influence, title rank, the chair's two, a Justice's one. Rival houses lean by `interest`: a target votes against its own censure, its allies with it; the poor vote down a levy; a region's lords vote for its relief; a losing belligerent begs for peace. Effects are data. Passing a motion lifts the proposer's standing in the Senate sphere; failing one costs it.

motions.name: Censure
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Senate censure {target} for conduct unbecoming a house of the Reach.

motions.name: Recognition
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Senate recognise the title and standing of {target}.

motions.name: The Levy
motions.description: {proposer} moves that every landed house pay a levy of three credits to the chair for the common defence.

motions.name: Relief
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Senate send relief to {target}: patrols on the lanes and grain for the worlds.

motions.name: The Peace of the Reach
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Senate impose the Peace of the Reach on the wars of {target}.

motions.name: Commission
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Senate commission {target} to the office of {office}.

motions.name: Act of the Senate
motions.description: {proposer} moves an Act of the Senate: that {law} be {option} throughout the Reach.

motions.name: Petition of an Estate
motions.description: {proposer} petition the Senate: that {law} be {option} throughout the Reach. If the chamber turns them away, every house they already distrust will feel it.

motions.name: War Beyond the Reach
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Reach make war upon {target}, and that every house with a fleet send it.

motions.name: Breaking of a Company
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Senate break up the greatest company {target} directs: its ventures sold off, its holders paid what the sale fetches.

motions.name: Rescue of the Exchange
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Reach's purse stand behind the Exchange: the chair pays, every company in the red is made whole, and confidence is held up for two years.

motions.name: Triumph
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Senate vote a triumph to the general of {target}, for victories won in the Reach's name.

motions.name: Recall
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the general of {target} lay down the command and come home to answer to the Senate.

motions.name: Embargo
motions.description: {proposer} moves that the Senate close the exchanges of the Reach to {target} for eight years.
